plan.title: Genotype x drug interaction DE and pathway analysis (heart, human)
plan.analytical_narrative: The data are raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 16 heart samples) from a 2x2x4 factorial: genotype (WT, KO) x treatment (vehicle, drug), 4 replicates per cell. The research question — does the drug act differently in KO than in WT — is a genotype:treatment interaction question, which DESeq2-family models test with an explicit interaction term. All work is done in Python (PyDESeq2 + GSEApy), per the user's constraint. The plan runs sample-structure QC first (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes) to catch outliers or batch structure before any test. It then fits the PyDESeq2 negative-binomial model with design ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, explicit reference levels (WT, vehicle), and tests the interaction coefficient with the Wald test — the primary answer to the research question. Because a low-power interaction test alone does not describe the biology, the plan also extracts the two simple effects (drug vs vehicle within WT; drug vs vehicle within KO) using a 4-level group-factor reparameterization with reference releveling, so that each simple effect is a single model coefficient and can be shrunk natively in PyDESeq2 (apeglm-style) without needing R/ashr interop, honoring the Python-only constraint. All three effects (WT simple effect, KO simple effect, interaction) get independent BH-FDR correction at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, reported separately with contrast labels, MA/dispersion diagnostics, and p-value histograms. Because gene symbols in counts.csv already match HGNC symbols used by the staged human gene set files, no ID mapping step is needed. Preranked GSEA (GSEApy) on the Wald statistic runs once per contrast against the staged MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (primary) and Reactome pathways (secondary, filtered to Homo sapiens), with the standard 15-500 gene set size window, redundancy collapse, and leading-edge reporting. A final report step assembles the QC, DE, and enrichment outputs into one document with full reproducibility metadata (package versions, seed, reference releases) and states explicitly that interaction power is low at 4 replicates per cell and that Cook's-distance-flagged genes get NA p-values rather than replacement at this replicate number.
